notes.title: Ninja or Die: Shadow of the Sun is available now!
notes.notes:
Hi Ninjas! 

It is time to jump into Edo Japan and take on hellish bosses and assassins equipped with projectiles, magic and agility! 

Ninja or Die: Shadow of the Sun is available now worldwide and for the week of launch you can also take advantage of a 10% discount. We've also got a brand new trailer to show you: 

[previewyoutube=ta7MuYJ-lgQ;full][/previewyoutube]

We're excited to see you master violent precision platforming in Ninja or Die: Shadow of the Sun so if you plan on streaming the game please let us know by tagging us on Twitter ([url=https://twitter.com/marvelouseurope]@MarvelousEurope[/url]) or commenting here!

notes.title: Ninja or Die: Shadow of the Sun releasing August 2nd
notes.notes:
Hi ninjas, 

We're excited to announce that Ninja or Die: Shadow of the Sun will be releasing August 2nd. 

To celebrate this announcement, we've made the latest version of the pre-release demo live for you to play until July 17 so get downloading! 

You can also see our new look for Ninja or Die: Shadow of the Sun in this demo as the main menu has been updated. Just a reminder that this demo does not contain all the shops, merchants, gameplay features and items from Ninja or Die: Shadow of the Sun, but it should give you an idea of how it plays. 

If you've got thoughts on what you've played or are planning to stream the demo please let us know in the comments or tweet us [url=https://twitter.com/marvelouseurope]@MarvelousEurope[/url], we'd love to see your feedback! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2090980/Ninja_or_Die/

Remember to wishlist and follow to stay up to date with all Ninja or Die: Shadow of the Sun news!

notes.title: Ninja or Die: Shadow of the Sun
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

We've got something exciting to show you today - our blazing new look and subtitle:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42806299/03da59b84ba1f57aca7b28ec579f23e6998c639e.jpg[/img]

"Shadow of the Sun" speaks to Ninja or Die's relationship with light and dark and hints at the celestial forces at play and specifically the intriguing influence of Amaterasu, Goddess of the Sun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42806299/f59d11bb0c50002111bd4c1574cfd4d2a9f88f09.jpg[/img]
We're also ready to share a little summary of the story at the heart of the game:

[i]Celestial doom. This is the fate that awaits humanity. In Edo, Japan, the great cataclysm has been foreseen by a most unlikely soul — a Master Thief. Your mother.

You are a common pickpocket, transformed by the cataclysm into a lethal Ninja with lightning mobility. The Ramen Seller becomes a Samurai. The Maiko becomes a killer Geisha. Your domain of petty crime becomes a frenzied neon world of shogun castles, magic traps and parachuting assassins. Someone has ensnared you in a loop of chaos… if not to kill you, then to protect you from something worse.[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2090980/Ninja_or_Die/

The team has been working on the game and making great progress and we hope to have more exciting news for you soon so don't forget to wishlist and let us know what you think of the new look!

notes.title: You can keep playing Ninja or Die until February 28th
notes.notes:
Hey ninjas,

Thank you so much if you've already played our Next Fest demo! If you haven't yet, we have some great news for you - the demo will be staying on the Ninja or Die page, available to download until February 28th. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2090980/Ninja_or_Die/ 

We really appreciate all the feedback we've received so far and the team is hard at work looking at your suggestions, fixing bugs, and updating the game so keep it coming please! Any notes you've got from playing the demo will help us give you the best experience at launch.

Just a reminder that this demo does not contain all the shops, merchants, gameplay features and items from Ninja or Die, but it should give you an idea of how it plays. Please note not everything in the demo is final and items may change before the game's release. Some glitches, bugs or issues may also still be in this demo as the full game is still being worked on. 

If you've got feedback or are planning to stream the demo please let us know in the comments or tweet us @MarvelousEurope!

notes.title: The Ninja or Die Demo is available now!
notes.notes:
Hey ninjas,

The demo for Ninja or Die is live now, go download! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2090980/Ninja_or_Die/ 

We're excited to hear what you have to say about Ninja or Die's demo so please let us know your thoughts after you've played and don't forget: this pre-release demo will only be available until February 13th so don't leave it too late to download! 

Just a reminder that you won't be able to access all the shops, merchants and items from in this demo, but you can test your strength in a never-ending challenge by visiting the Infinite Watchtower once you complete the first few levels. 

While the demo should give you an idea of how Ninja or Die plays, please note not everything in the demo is final and items may change before the game's release. Some glitches, bugs or issues may also still be in this demo as the full game is still being worked on. Any feedback you have from playing this demo will be incredibly valuable and will help us make sure you get the best experience at launch.

If you're planning to stream the demo let us know in the comments or tweet us @MarvelousEurope!

notes.title: Demo dropping at February Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Hey ninjas, 

Dropping in with a quick update to let you know you'll be able to play a Ninja or Die demo in the upcoming Steam Next Fest, this 6-13 February! 

We're excited to get your impressions of the game and so we're releasing a demo showcasing the first few levels, your home base, and one of the game's infinite run challenges. The demo will only be available during Next Fest so make sure you get downloading before February 13th! 

You won't be able to access all the shops, merchants and items from the full game within the demo, but the Infinite Watchtower will be open for visitors so once you complete the first few levels you can test your might in a never-ending challenge.

This pre-release demo should give you a good indication of Ninja or Die's gameplay, but please note that not everything included is final and the levels you play may change before the game's release. Some glitches, bugs or issues may also be present as the game is still being worked on. Any feedback you have from playing this demo will be incredibly valuable and will help us make sure you get the best experience at launch. 

On that note, we're excited to see what you think of the game so keep an eye on here on February 6th and we’ll let you know when to get downloading! If you're planning to play or stream the demo let us know in the comments or tweet us [url=https://twitter.com/marvelouseurope]@MarvelousEurope[/url].

notes.title: The first of 2023's updates!
notes.notes:
Happy New Year, ninjas!

We want to keep you updated with some of the changes that have been implemented in the last couple of months in Ninja or Die.

One of the main things we want to share with you is that we're testing Steam Deck functionality. We can't confirm anything right now but as soon as we know what's possible, we'll make sure to update you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42806299/df44e98ce868943bfb31f17af6b5a0632ce183b4.gif[/img]

Work on the cave area is progressing. This is a dark space so most of the fighting will take place in confined areas and your dodging skills will prove to be valuable here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42806299/91ce4811ec19e70a26c3b220773ae25ebbe0a13f.gif[/img]

Some areas are a bit unstable, so floors will collapse. Be careful that you don't fall through!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42806299/443a4fd2b2b44f843aa365f91423cec1443c20f0.gif[/img]

Additional traps have been added - you can see here the oil trap which creates a lot of resistance for jumps, the poison mists which continuously deal damage to you and the confusion smoke which disorientates you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42806299/6289090dbf9ad5295ced116fc328c716df725a57.gif[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42806299/087ac460e789f851b2a64c0b267a69e24a42fdbd.gif[/img]

Some additional weapons, armour, scrolls have been added as well as some quality of life improvements have been made such as re-balancing some of the enemies and the ability to move the camera independently of your position. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42806299/bdca7b07c3950baab603b3d06313ba133d38a08b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42806299/6a27ce85ce276248a3052c8de053abe7cb934de7.gif[/img]

We want to celebrate your achievements - some Steam Achievements are now in-game with more to come. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42806299/e911eb3189854fef0101724f68c69db01ee784d3.png[/img]

We leave you with the news that a demo will be available for you to try out soon so make sure to wishlist and follow us on here to find out when it's live!

notes.title: Updates & Fixes!
notes.notes:
Hi Ninjas! 

We were delighted to be featured within [b]The MIX[/b] - where we showcased some of the amazing gameplay you can experience within the game.

[previewyoutube=dZ4Ae4fvUVw;full][/previewyoutube]

Here you can see developer of Ninja or Die, Nao Games, walk us through a variety of different gameplay mechanics, updated graphics and give an overall insight into the game and what you can experience!

We, of course, want to keep you up to date with the other changes we are continuing to make - so here's another insight into all the exciting new changes, updated features and fun sneak peaks:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42806299/25edaad1993c37806a26df3582bf6b3a506cbaa4.gif[/img]

New addition to the title screen!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42806299/d9e82464ba662aa4689ff453539797a8ea694be0.gif[/img]

We've updated the warehouse appearance when reinforcing - the better the reinforcements, the bigger the warehouse!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42806299/6e8db5a50e2f0103978c35e8511f83d45489c062.gif[/img]

A merchant has now been created - shop for all your needs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42806299/ad5da3de78a1272ed158e5ad00aa9006fff27fff.gif[/img]

As seen in our last update, the forest boss is now ready!

We also made updates to our enemies within the game, here's a sneak peek:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42806299/d90f481dd599ee6da1cf524d55e70bf4108634fd.gif[/img]

We have lots more updates to share very soon so stay tuned, or you can follow Nao Games on [url=https://twitter.com/nao_peca]Twitter[/url] to keep up to date!

notes.title: Latest updates!
notes.notes:
Hi Ninjas! 

We've got plenty to show you as we go behind the scenes for a sneak peak at the latest changes and additions to Ninja or Die! 

A tutorial has now been implemented so you can get to grips with the gameplay before you take on the larger challenge. You will need to complete this section to move on, but it will be helpful in teaching you all the tips and tricks of Ninja or Die! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42806299/0700a779681cf4246c4c4bab27de5ad3e7a55311.gif[/img]

Locked Doors have now appeared. Find the key, get through the door - pretty easy, right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42806299/4472cf9d6396187761ff736f2a091a2112e75900.gif[/img]

Watch out for the blast! (Exploding traps have now been added to the game.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42806299/7fe333fd51fd744647f486e6494c6a3fed5a1bac.gif[/img]

If you've played the game at EGX or TGS you have already seen that when you jump you are now invincible. Here’s an official explainer of how it works: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42806299/627702110d2b7293b372f0205cf4bedadb6e7e64.gif[/img]

Embrace the chaos with this new sequence attack pattern displayed by one of the first bosses in the game: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42806299/102ad872565d8a17474932af96c82a7e5f923856.gif[/img]

The Forest area has now flourished and is coming together:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42806299/51bd3f2075312d9caddfc49bb8fd39e617edd647.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42806299/6c72eb79a9b16c7f38c99641e4ed4bbb65e75755.gif[/img]

While some of the enemies might not have arrived in this part of the Forest just yet, this luscious green arena is beginning to take shape! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42806299/7018f54ef2dd4231298c327291b15009aa39c28f.gif[/img]

If you played Ninja or Die at EGX or TGS or wishlisted the title on here we'd like to thank you for your support and your time. Stay tuned as we hope to show you more soon!

notes.title: Events & Updates!
notes.notes:
Hi ninjas! 

We’re very excited to share some Ninja or Die updates and also to give you some dates for when you can play an early version of the game!

A few media got to play Ninja or Die at Gamescom and we’re so happy to report that they really enjoyed it! [url=https://www.vg247.com/ninja-or-die-is-a-genius-indie-and-gamescom-2022s-best-kept-secret]VG247 called Ninja or Die a “genius indie” and the “best kept secret of Gamescom”[/url] and [url=https://www.nme.com/features/gaming-features/the-best-games-of-gamescom-2022-3300858]NME named it one of the best games of the show[/url]. 

To give you a chance to see for yourself what the fuss is all about, we will be at [url=https://tgs.nikkeibp.co.jp/tgs/2022/en/]Tokyo Game Show[/url] this weekend! If you are at the show, come find the iGi (indie Game incubator) booth and try your hand at traversing the planes of medieval Japan in lightning-fast style with Ninja or Die. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42806299/9753505e5266603ab199ec0661875accbb6c794b.jpg[/img]

But that’s not all! In Europe, next week (22-25th September) we will be at [url=https://www.egx.net/london/en-gb.html]EGX in London[/url] as part of the Tentacle Zone. Come and find us, unleash the power of the Ninja and you could get a killer little sticker depending on how well you do! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42806299/d359c106d9cdbba6baa105f2cdef23a831caca43.jpg[/img]

Before we leave you, we also have a few gameplay updates from what you’ve seen in the trailer. (and what critics have played at Gamescom). 

Secret passages and break-able objects are coming to Ninja or Die and you can see them below! 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42806299/c56c025443bcd61c1ee67a6404aba3449d927c4c.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42806299/c56c025443bcd61c1ee67a6404aba3449d927c4c.gif[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42806299/14b0a7de467a5f0ea96bc04c07d506d46e326f45.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42806299/14b0a7de467a5f0ea96bc04c07d506d46e326f45.gif[/img][/url]

A number of quality of life improvements have been made ahead of TGS and EGX so that you get the best experience while playing Ninja or Die! One of the biggest updates is that your ninja is now invincible when jumping and additional changes have been made to the secret agents regarding their abilities to parry. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42806299/5862d7ec024538de4019d1f88d70a6dae2a75444.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42806299/5862d7ec024538de4019d1f88d70a6dae2a75444.gif[/img][/url]

We don’t want to say too much and spoil the surprise so come and play this early version of Ninja or Die at one of the events and let us know what you think!

notes.title: Are you ready to unleash the power and speed of the Ninja?
notes.notes:
Today we get to show you a new title coming in 2023 as we reveal Ninja or Die alongside Nao Games! 

Ninja or Die is a killer fusion of brutal challenge and elegant simplicity, combining extreme speed with a unique control scheme. You can see it in action in the trailer below: 

[previewyoutube=94IVbgfT0p0;full][/previewyoutube]

You must master violent precision platforming in medieval Japan as a lethal Secret Agent with lightning mobility. Make strategic use of minimalist controls to blaze through frenetic 2D stages that lead you deeper and deeper into a Ninja-eat-Ninja world of bloodshed and deception.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2090980/extras/boss2.gif?t=1660558388[/img]

In Ninja or Die you will get to immerse yourself in hardcore action portrayed in beautiful retro pixel art that will leave you dead and wanting more.

We're excited to reveal more soon ahead of the release in 2023, but for now, please wishlist Ninja or Die to be kept up to date with news!
